title: 50 000 Guaranies (Series H-K)

obverse.description:
Purple, green and light brown on multicolor underprint.
Agustín Pío Barríos "Mangore" holding guitar at center, face value combining numbers and letters on top an lower left; and on numbers and on letters on center right. issuer name on top right, security thread to right of center, see-thru device (guitar shape) on lower left, the 2 official coats of arms on sides on lettered face of value (right). 
Red vertical serial #s on left, black horizontal on lower right.
obverse.lettering:
50 MIL
BANCO CENTRAL DEL PARAGUAY
EL BANCO CENTRAL DEL PARAGUAY
RECONOCE ESTE BILLETE POR
50000
AÑO 2015
CINCUENTA MIL GUARANIES
ESTE BILETE TIENE CURSO LEGAL Y FUERZA CANCELATORIA ILIMITADA EN TODO EL TERRITORIO DE LA REPUBLICA (LEY 489 DEL 29 JUNIO DE 1995).
obverse.lettering_translation:
50 Thousand
Central Bank of Paraguay
The Central Bank of Paraguay accept this banknote for
Year 2015
Fifty Thousand Guaranies
This banknote is legal tender and has unlimited validity on all the Republic territory (Law 489 from June 29th., 1995).

reverse.description:
Multicolor print.
Central part of guitar, stylized "Ñanduty" design, face value on numbers to left, combined numbers and letters on top right, country name on top, face value in Guarani language on bottom.
reverse.lettering:
REPUBLICA DEL PARAGUAY        50 MIL 
50000
POPA SU GUARANI
reverse.lettering_translation:
Republic of Paraguay           50 Thousand
Fifty Thousand Guaranies (Guarani language)

comments:
Agustín Pío Barrios (1885-1944), also known as "Nitsuga Mangoré" or "Mangoré", was the most famous Paraguayan classic guitar player, considered the best musician at his country.

Trivia: "Nitsuga" is Agustin spelled backwards.
